_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits on the Disbelief/Hope edge in a documented coil; base rate favors HOLD until a spot breaker (momentum/funding or F&G) actually prints.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both cautionary, but analyst explicit HOLD/Hope vs narrative distribution lean; no shared directional break call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 55-70 and 30d momentum stays 50-70 with funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum >80 with funding >70, or F&G <45 with momentum <40
